ai_summary.key_headline: La Roja's Positional Overloads Meet Resilient Blue Sharks Defensive Block

spain.philosophy: High-possession positional play with rapid ball circulation and active wingers.

cape_verde.philosophy: Low-block defensive organization with explosive direct wing outlets.

tactical_insights: Spain will look to use Nico Williams and Lamine Yamal to stretch Cape Verde's backline and create gaps centrally.
On their World Cup debut, Cape Verde will defend deep and seek to spring direct transitions through captain Ryan Mendes.
Rodri's role in controlling the midfield and stopping Cape Verde's counter-attacks early will be vital.
